li.label: failed flagellation
li.description: The ritual left no scars at all. What was the point of the ceremony if my devotion is not written on my flesh?

li.label: underwhelming flagellation
li.description: I bear only a few new scars. It hardly feels like enough to properly mark my devotion.

li.label: satisfying flagellation
li.description: I bear several new ritual scars. My devotion is written into my flesh once again.

li.label: exemplary flagellation
li.description: My body is covered in new ritual scars. I have never felt more proud to wear my devotion so openly.
